behavior: Query, manual text/fast indexing, automatic text batches, manual visual rebuild and automatic visual batches own their actual detached task and actor completion through Quit, switch, wipe and encrypted lock.

Query replacement invalidates its generation and cancels old work immediately; retired/draining entry points cannot begin new work or publish stale results. The 150ms debounce stays owned and cancelable.

Automatic text and visual indexing run finite batches and resume only after the completed job leaves the registry. Idle polling is not modeled as an immortal owned worker.

Privacy-erasure confirmation cancels earlier query/index/source/import jobs, clears already-read results, and rejects pending note, JSON and audio admission in the covered paths. Completed commits remain unless separately erased.
